Our litigation targets the specific enforceable gap: ApexAI's refusal to adopt the same weight-containment and human-authored evaluation standards every other domestic developer has accepted. If the real design is a fixed line above your frontier and below ours, we will know it, and we will draw the appropriate conclusions about whether American verification proposals are technical instruments or intelligence instruments.
